actor: hyperscaler investor-relations disclosure lead (Microsoft, Meta, Oracle)
job: Preparing FY2026-27 earnings calls and SEC filings, deciding whether datacenter capex is presented in aggregate or itemized by chip vendor

motivation: Aggregate capex is standard practice, protects vendor pricing confidentiality, and no rule compels itemizing a single chip supplier

task.why: protect confidentiality; follow standard aggregate reporting

outcome: Quantified procurement stays internal; no first-party capex statement surfaces an AMD-specific dollar, rack, or GPU number externally
motivation: Internal planning needs exact numbers, but vendor NDAs and aggregate external reporting keep those figures unpublished

task.what: book AMD capacity internally without external quantification
task.why: vendor NDAs and aggregate-reporting norms block disclosure

outcome: Commitments stay framed in gigawatts with no customer-cosigned dollar, rack, or GPU disclosure - sustaining the power-denominated framing
motivation: Power framing maximizes headline scale while shielding per-customer pricing and volume terms from competitors and analysts

task.why: protect customer pricing and volume confidentiality
